notes.title: Update Notes for 04/12/2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Tree tilt has been adjusted to not allow climbing
[*] Minimum height for fall damage increased
[*] Crate spawn fixed
[*] Fixed knife damage
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who tested the game and reported their issues!

I especially thank [url=https://www.twitch.tv/00mx]00Mx[/url], a Brazilian streamer who gave me excellent feedback.

If you would like to give me feedback about the game or report issues, please contact me by email: [u]gabrieljacintho@fireringstudio.com[/u].
